scope: analysis only: no training, no new inference, no official-test per-sample access; uses frozen development/calibration predictions, published test aggregates, and public literature
question: IMDB accuracy 还有多少提升空间，应该如何优化
headline: Full-coverage 98% is effectively unreachable under the current fixed splits, sealed test, and local-only compute; the current 97.028% test result is already near the publicly verifiable ceiling and near the human-validated 2.90% test-label-noise ceiling. Realistic remaining full-coverage headroom is ~+0.1-0.3 pp and requires a genuinely new model/training signal, not post-processing. The only verified >=98% result is selective classification: 99.23% retained accuracy at 88.93% actual test coverage.

error_structure.caveat: classification is AI qualitative review, not independent human adjudication; conflicts are candidates, not confirmed mislabels

oracles.caveat: label-aware post-hoc upper bounds over a pool containing near-duplicates and post-hoc views; not deployable accuracy

label_noise.source: Northcutt et al., NeurIPS 2021 D&B, arXiv:2103.14749 Table 1/2 (re-checked 2026-10-18); see literature.md

local_training_review.caveat: not a general training-pool noise rate

label_noise.caveat: 2.90% is a human-validated lower-bound estimate; 97.10% is this report's arithmetic ceiling, not a proven bound

higher_claims_status.cfa_heterogeneous_ensemble_97.072: combination/hyperparameters selected on test performance; unreplicated

literature_context.assessment: no verified, protocol-compliant, independently replicated full-test >=97.0% result found; 98% full coverage is not supported by public evidence

optimization_options.name: new genuinely diverse strong model (DeBERTa-v3-large seed 43 or another family)
optimization_options.gate: frozen ensemble dev >= 97.55% and net +3 vs 2435 and nested-calibration-CV fluctuation < 0.3 pp

optimization_options.name: DAPT/TAPT on official 50k unlabeled reviews (semi-supervised protocol, disclose)
retrain on user-revised labels (61 flips, 3 deletions; Laya already +0.08 pp n.s.)
selective classification with frozen calibration thresholds
optimization_options.status: already achieved: 99.23% at 88.93% actual coverage (not full coverage)

do_not_do: more fusion-weight / view / window / calibration search on frozen outputs (saturated at 2435, p=0.25)
dev-set-driven selection of seed/epoch/TTA/members (dev reused; optimistic)
official-test tuning, weight changes, or candidate re-selection (test already used; not independent)
LLM prompting/QLoRA as a classifier (no evidence; local weights absent; GPT-4 zero-shot 96.40%, Llama-3-8B QLoRA 91.2%)
external labeled data or test-text adaptation (out of scope / violates sealing)
relabeling dev/test to report higher accuracy
recommendation: Stop gain search and package the course deliverables: report 97.028% full-coverage test + 99.23% at 88.93% coverage selective result + error/label-noise analysis + negative results; present 98% as a research aspiration with the three supporting facts (public comparable SOTA ~96.8%, human-validated 2.90% test label noise implying ~97.10% ceiling, two-view oracle 97.88%). If the user explicitly wants one more attempt, run at most P1 or P2 with the predeclared gate; expected test 97.1-97.5%, not 98%.

discrepancies_found_and_status: D1 medium: experiment-plan stale 75% capture argument -> rewritten to 32.6% (15/46) / 36.7% (18/49); fixed post-verification
D2 low: experiment-plan 'test 90% coverage' -> corrected to calibration target 90% / actual coverage 88.932%; fixed
D3 low: experiment-plan residual balance direction -> corrected to >=1.43 (worst-case lower bound); fixed
D4 low: literature 'only higher claim' wording -> qualified; fixed
D5-D7 minor narrative/denominator wording; disclosed, no impact on headline numbers

limitations: official test is not independent (historically used); its numbers are aggregate copies, not re-verified per sample
development set was reused across many studies; all dev deltas are exploratory
oracles are label-aware post-hoc upper bounds, not deployable accuracy
68-error classification and label-noise anchors are AI qualitative, not human adjudication
external literature numbers are self-reported and were not re-run by the project; some sources were inaccessible
inventory completeness relies on the analyst's provenance scan (2,035 files scanned, 587 test-path files skipped)
no new training/inference was performed in this research round; all P1-P4 expectations are estimates
